'''Hangar Two''' was one of the [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] in the [[Polis Massa Base (Rebel Alliance)|Polis Massa Rebel Base]] It contained a squadron of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The hangar was built under low buildings on [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa's]] surface about twelve [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from [[Hangar One (Polis Massa Rebel Base)|Hangar One]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
